test_inputs.explanation: The agent repeatedly navigated to the Magento admin catalog category page at http://dockerized-magento.local/index.php/admin/catalog_category/, so admin_base_url is set to http://dockerized-magento.local/index.php/admin. The execution summary did not capture form-field values, so required fields use typical/default choices that allow replay: parent_category set to the common tree root 'Default Category', name set to a test name 'New Category (automated)', and active/include_in_menu both set to 'Yes'. Optional fields (url_key, store_view, description, display_mode, is_anchor) are left empty to let Magento defaults apply.
